Hi Laura / Marissa —

We're requesting permission to open a backfill requisition for the Inference Platform on-call rotation. Summary:

- Reason: Backfill — Sam Liu (IC-4) submitted resignation effective 8/15; we need overlap for knowledge transfer and on-call continuity
- Proposed band: US IC-4 salary band (range included in attached JD)
- Timeline: open req this week, first screens week of 7/27, target offer by mid-August to ensure overlap

Attachments: JD_Inference-Platform-IC4.pdf, req-approval-matrix.xlsx

Immediate asks:
1) Laura: approval to open the req against headcount code 3-PLATFORM-203 (or tell me which code to use)
2) Marissa: confirmation you can start a quick slate and prioritize any candidates already in pipeline (I have a good referral: Jordan Price; scheduled phone screen 7/20)

I've included Stephanie since SRE will own interview panel for on-call readiness. Let me know if you need more info; flagging this as somewhat urgent because of overlap risk.

Thanks,

Thanks for the write-up, Connor. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
- Cost center: confirm which cost center will pick this up (is this PLATFORM central or split across teams?)
- Budget: do we expect comp above midpoint for a referral hire (Jordan)? If yes, include justification
- Pipeline: any other strong prospects besides Jordan? If there are qualified internal transfers, we should prioritize them for speed

If you can reply with the above, I'll route to finance and approve the req.

Appreciate the urgency — keep this tight.

Laura — answers below:
- Cost center: PLATFORM central (3-PLATFORM-203). This will be charged to Platform (no cross-charge).
- Budget: comp band = IC-4 midpoint; referral candidate (Jordan Price) is within band and has senior LLM infra experience. If comp needs to go above midpoint for counteroffers we'll provide written justification and sign-off.
- Pipeline: Jordan Price (referral) + 2 inbound PS-qualified candidates from recruiter; no internal transfers currently flagged.
- Headcount origin: backfill for Sam — net headcount unchanged.

Next steps: Marissa, please open GH job GH-9876 and create initial slate. I'm asking Erin Walsh (TalentPartners) to prioritize screening calendar for next week. Jordan's phone screen already scheduled 7/20 at 11am PT.

Also note: we have a short interview rubric for on-call readiness (link in related_links). I propose an expedited interview loop: phone screen -> technical take-home (2 hr) -> 2 panel interviews (runtime + operations), target total loop 10 business days.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Connor
